title: Japan's embassy in Uzbekistan suspends online visa appointment booking after repeated cases of unauthorized access, it says
date_note: The page gives only its publication day (24 November 2026, 10:12); no earlier suspension day is stated.
geo_basis: country as the source states it; the page does not name a city
summary: Podrobno.uz reports that the Embassy of Japan in Uzbekistan temporarily suspended its online visa appointment system after repeated cases of unauthorized access. The embassy says slots will reopen gradually once the system can be run securely and asked people not to log in unless necessary. Residence-certificate holders and people with a foreign-ministry note can request an appointment by email.
plain: Japan's embassy in Uzbekistan paused online visa booking, citing repeated cases of unauthorized access to the system. It will reopen slots gradually.
exec: Visa applicants to Japan in Uzbekistan cannot book online for now, according to the embassy as reported by Podrobno.uz.
action: The embassy asks people not to log in to the booking system unless urgent; per Podrobno.uz, residence-certificate (COE) holders and people with a foreign-ministry note may email documents for an appointment date.

validation.note: Only Podrobno.uz (Russian), quoting the embassy, was read; the embassy's own notice was not found.

review.note: wording stronger/different than source: attempts now repeated cases of unauthorized access; action clarified
